rules.condition: required envelope field is null or schema_version is not supported
rules.description: event_id, event_ts, ingest_ts, source_id, plant_id, sequence, schema_name, schema_version, correlation_id, classification, and payload are mandatory.

rules.condition: event_id does not match UUIDv7 format
rules.description: The v1 contract requires a globally unique time-ordered UUIDv7 event ID.

rules.condition: event_ts > ingest_ts + 5 seconds and clock_mode != accelerated
rules.description: Future event time is allowed only for the explicitly accelerated synthetic clock.

rules.condition: environment == demo and (data_classification != SYNTHETIC or privacy_label != DEMO-NONPERSONAL or plant_id does not start NS-DEMO-)
rules.description: Demo isolation is a startup and per-row assertion.

rules.condition: same event_id has more than one distinct payload_hash
rules.description: Conflicting duplicates are evidence and cannot be resolved by last-write-wins.

rules.condition: same event_id and payload_hash appears more than once
rules.description: Exact at-least-once duplicates are idempotently removed and counted.

rules.condition: no dim_plant, dim_asset, or dim_sensor SCD2 row is valid at event_ts
rules.description: Facts resolve reference state at event time, not ingest time.

rules.condition: validity intervals overlap or active natural key has other than one current row
rules.description: Intervals are half-open [valid_from, valid_to) and cannot overlap.

rules.condition: event unit is not the sensor registry canonical unit or an explicitly versioned compatible conversion
rules.description: Bad unit mappings are never silently converted.

rules.condition: numeric value is NaN, positive infinity, or negative infinity
rules.description: Only finite numeric values enter silver.

rules.condition: source_quality not in GOOD, UNCERTAIN, BAD, STALE, SUBSTITUTED
rules.description: Enumerations are case-sensitive and versioned.

rules.condition: ingest_ts - event_ts exceeds configured policy watermark
rules.description: Late records within the watermark retain late_flag=true; beyond-policy records remain queryable in quarantine.

rules.condition: healthy observation falls outside sensor hard_min/hard_max
rules.description: At least 99.7% of healthy observations should lie inside configured hard ranges.

rules.condition: cooling outlet temperature is below inlet beyond tolerance during heat extraction
rules.description: Cooling-water direction is a physical invariant.

rules.condition: furnace heat balance absolute error > 5% or rolling mass balance absolute error > 0.8% or interval energy reconciliation absolute error > 1.5%
rules.description: Published KPI facts must reconcile to the documented physical tolerances.

rules.condition: rul_days_p10 < 0 or not (rul_days_p10 < rul_days_p50 and rul_days_p50 < rul_days_p90)
rules.description: RUL is non-negative and uncertainty quantiles are ordered.

rules.condition: predicted lining thickness increases without a recorded repair/reline event
rules.description: The physics-informed monotonicity constraint is enforced.

rules.condition: hard_constraint_violations != 0
rules.description: No optimizer result may be published as feasible after relaxing a hard production, safety, quality, or contractual constraint.

rules.condition: complete_audit_flag != true for an issued recommendation
rules.description: KPI-GOV-01 requires complete inputs/version/output/confidence/human-decision lineage.

rules.condition: seed == 240726 and component_id == HEARTH-SECTOR-07 and not (rul_days_p50 within configured 21-day tolerance and risk_score >= 0.80)
rules.description: The deterministic lining-warning cue must match the signed manifest.

rules.condition: seed == 240727 and not (optimized_cost_eur < baseline_cost_eur and hard_constraint_violations == 0)
rules.description: The deterministic energy scenario must reduce cost with equal planned tonnage and no hard violation.

rules.condition: seed == 240728 and quality warning does not precede first off-spec result
rules.description: The deterministic quality warning must precede visible failure and improve predicted first-pass yield.

reconciliation.formula: bronze_rows = silver_rows + exact_duplicate_rows + unique_quarantined_input_rows; quarantine reason rows are separately counted and may exceed unique quarantined inputs
